name: Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Blueberry'
story_html: The Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Blueberry' utilizes sunrise-inspired stitch lines on the white tumbled leather upper, featuring lizard-textured overlays in a royal blue finish. Jumpman branding decorates the tongue and heel tab. Performance benefits include a lightweight Phylon midsole with full-length Zoom Air cushioning. Underfoot, the blue rubber outsole features herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate.
